(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; External Affairs; Housing and

14
Sethusamudram Canal
*41. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether according to the book
entitled "Images India", published by NRSA
(National Remote Sensing Agency),
satellite images have revealed that "an
ancient bridge existed between India and
Sri Lanka in Palk Strait";
(b) if so, whether Government is also
aware that a large number of people in the
country consider Ram Setu/Adams bridge,
a national monument due to its antiquity
and unique features/historical importance
in Ram Charit Manas; and
(c) if so, Government's final decision
regarding construction of Sethusamudram
Canal by dredging a portion of Ram Setu
and whether the same has been conveyed
to the Supreme Court?
Preparations for Beijing Olympics
*42. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) the preparations made for winning
more medals in the forthcoming Beijing
Olympics;
(b) whether any steps have been taken
to sort out the problems being faced by our
athletes and sports persons which prevent
them from winning medals at Olympic
Games even though we are the second largest
country in the world;
(c) if so, the specific steps taken by
Government during each of the last three
years in this regard and the sports and
events in which our sports-persons are
expected to excel during the forthcoming
Olympic games; and
(d) the amount spent by the Union
Government on preparations for Olympics,
so far?

Employees in PSUs under CIT
*43. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in PSUs under the administrative
control of his Ministry as on 31 March,
2007, unit-wise break-up; and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in each of
these units as on 31 March, 2007?
Software for registered farmers
*44. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether IIT, Bombay has developed
a software with which registered farmers
can have their queries answered on a  mobile
phone without having to go to a kiosk or
cyber cafe;
(b) if so, will farmers from Vidarbha
region be made familiar with such a cost-
effective mechanism through which they
get answers to their agriculture and animal
husbandry related questions; and
(c) the cost involved and the time-frame
for starting the functioning of this software
from Vidarbha?
Reducing CER at garbage dumps
*45. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued
directions to different Municipalities and
State Governments to cut Carbon Emission
Rates (CER) by treating the garbage dumps
using new capping techniques and
economizing the space covered by dumping
grounds; and
(b) if so, the CERs earned thereby by
Municipalities in different metropolises per
annum as a result of such efforts?
Completion of EW and NS corridors
*46. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) by when the East-West and North-
South corridors of the National Highways
would be completed;
(b) the distance in kilometres that needs
to be completed; and
(c) the problems being faced in its
completion?
Extraction of dolomite from Bhutan
*47. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to refer
to the answer to Unstarred Question 467
given in the Rajya Sabha on 22nd
November, 2007 and state:
(a) when was the Joint Technical Team
constituted; and
(b) the action taken on the
recommendation of the Joint Technical
Team so far?
Shift in flow of Ganga river
*48. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to worst
environmental conditions on the Gangotri

16

glacier in the Himalaya Mountain, the flow
of river Ganga has gone for away from the
main source 'Gaumukh';
(b)  if so, whether any survey has been
conducted in this regard;
(c) if so, the details and the outcome
thereof; and
(d) the steps taken/being taken by
Government to bring back the flow of river
Ganga to 'Gaumukh'?
Notification of rules under the Forest
Act
*49. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the rules under the Forest
Act have been notified and the Act enforced;
(b) if so, when and the details thereof;
and
(c) whether those tribals evicted from
their homes in the absence of the law and
the rules have been restored with their
homestead?
Proposals for inter-State roads from
Rajasthan
*50. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether some proposals of
Rajasthan State with regard to inter-State
roads are pending with the Central
Government;
(b) the number of estimates of inter-
State roads that are pending with
Government for technical approval and
financial sanction and the time since when
they are pending; and
(c) the number of proposals and
estimates which have been cleared by
Government and when such clearance was
accorded and which proposals/estimates are
proposed to be cleared in the Budget-2008?
Employees working in shipyards
*51. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING , ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in shipyards under the
administrative control of his Ministry as
on 31 March 2007, unit-wise; and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in these units
as on the 31 March, 2007?
Upgradation to National Highways in
Andhra Pradesh
*52. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of  SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has received
any proposal from the States to upgrade
State roads into National Highways during
the last three years;
(b) if so, whether the State of Andhra
Pradesh has sought upgradations of about
4,590 km. of State roads into National
Highways;
(c) if so, the State road projects for
which upgradations have been accepted
alongwith financial allocations provided to
execute the projects, proposal-wise; and

17
(d) the rationale for not upgrading the
State roads of Andhra Pradesh?
Explosion in Jubiliant Organosys at
Gajraula
*53. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that local residents have fled after
hearing the news of explosion in Jubiliant
Organosys situated at Gajraula in Uttar
Pradesh in the recent past;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the efforts made/proposed to be
made by Government to ensure
enforcement of environmental norms in the
factories located in this area in order to
ensure safety of public at large;
(d) the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons for neglecting the
safety of public?
Sports and cultural activities in
Assam
*54. KUMAR DEEPAK DAS: Will the
Minister of  DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of projects sanctioned in
Assam for development of sports and
cultural activities during last three years,
district-wise; and
(b) the present status of implementation
of these projects?
Appointment of Lok Pal
*55. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister has
received a letter from the Lok Sevak Sangh
of Servants of People Society, New Delhi,
demanding immediate appointment of Lok
Pal, disqualification of candidates with
corrupt and criminal antecedents, and
forfeiture of illegally acquired property of
public servants including Ministers, MPs
and MLAs;
(b) whether the Second Administrative
Reforms Commission in its fourth Report,
has also supported the above mentioned
three demands; and
(c) if so, the time Government is likely
to take to come forward with a legislation
on Lok Pal?
Protest by Chinese Government
*56. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of  EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Chinese Government
has lodged an informal protest over the
Indian Prime Minister's visit to Arunachal
Pradesh, recently;
(b) if so, the facts thereof;
(c) whether the Government of China
is still considering Arunachal Pradesh as
their part;
(d) if so, whether Government has taken
up/propose to take up the issue with the
Chinese Government for an amicable
solution; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Shortage of houses
*57. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of  HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
shortage of twenty-five million houses in
the urban areas of the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
estimated shortage of dwelling units in the
next year is likely to be far greater than the
shortage, the country would face during
the Eleventh Plan period;
(c) if so, whether Government has
formulated any housing policy for urban
areas in the country; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to implement
the above policy in the country?
Indias' meetings with IAEA
*58. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that talks are on
between representatives of India and
International Atomic Energy Agency under
Indo-US nuclear pact agreement;
(b) if so, the number of rounds of talks
so far held in this regard;
(c) whether it has become a
controversial issue between both the parties
during the talks; and
(d) by when the talks are likely to
become a success?
Arresting migration to urban areas
*59. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
HOUSING AND URBAN POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any policy to make
life in rural areas livable and also provide
employment there, so that the inflow to
urban areas is arrested; and
(b) if not, the other measures undertaken
to help the urban poor?
ISRO's help to Israel in launching
satellite
*60. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Israel recently
availed of the expertise/facilities of ISRO
for launching their satellite into the space;
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the process of the mutual negotiation which
culminated into the final launching in
chronological order;
(c) the terms of the service;
(d) whether the expertise/facilities of
ISRO are offered to other countries as well
as commercial venture/bilateral agreements;
(e) whether any protocol is adhered to
necessitating prior disclosure of the purpose
of a proposed satellite, etc.;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) the activities proposed for the Israeli
satellite?
